bullets.text: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority during a 2017 military crackdown, an unprecedented verdict for the top UN court.
A boat carrying between 50 and 100 migrants has sunk off the coast of Senegal, with dozens missing and at least four bodies recovered.
One in four women globally, and almost half in West and Central Africa, are unable to refuse sex within marriage, according to a UN report, with girls being the most affected group.
Staffers for NSW politicians are reportedly experiencing 'unprecedented' levels of violence, prompting their union to raise alarms about security.
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen to discuss trade and balance Australia's relationship with Beijing.
Five teenage boys have been charged by Queensland Police in connection with an allegedly fatal shooting outside a pub in Logan.
AI giant Anthropic has made its Wall Street debut, with its stock beginning to trade after raising $81 billion in a record initial public offering.
Latin American currencies, including the Mexican peso and Brazilian real, experienced a significant sell-off due to mounting rate worries, prompting Brazil's central bank to intervene.
The Federal Reserve has informed employees at its regional branches to anticipate lower pay increases in 2027.
